rules.wind: nearest shore station within 7 km with wind on 200+ hours of the window: an airport ASOS (Iowa Environmental Mesonet), or a fixed NDBC/NOS met station the app shows as beach wind (NDBC_EXPOSURE pier or cove, src/ocean/shoreWind.ts); where the repo's enclosed-water mask covers the station it must also be outside enclosed water.
